stat_statements.query:
INSERT INTO sales.order_items (order_id, sku, qty, unit_cents)
  SELECT $1+(g%$2), $3||(g%$4), $5+(g%$6), (g*$7)%$8 FROM generate_series($9,$10) g
ANALYZE

INSERT INTO sales.orders (customer_id, status, total_cents)
  SELECT $1+(g%$2), (ARRAY[$3,$4,$5,$6])[$7+(g%$8)], (g*$9)%$10 FROM generate_series($11,$12) g
CREATE DATABASE "shopdb"
SELECT * FROM sales.v_order_totals ORDER BY total_cents DESC LIMIT $1
SELECT o.status, avg(oi.unit_cents) FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.status
INSERT INTO billing.invoices (order_id, amount_cents) SELECT $1+(g%$2), (g*$3)%$4 FROM generate_series($5,$6) g

INSERT INTO billing.payments (invoice_id, method, captured_at)
  SELECT $1+(g%$2), (ARRAY[$3,$4,$5])[$6+(g%$7)], now() - (g||$8)::interval FROM generate_series($9,$10) g

WITH
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $1,               $2,
    $3,            $4,
    $5,       now(),
    $6,         version(),
    $7,     current_setting($8)::int,
    $9,           current_database(),
    $10,    pg_encoding_to_char(
                            (SELECT encoding FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database())),
    $11,         current_setting($12)::int,
    $13, current_setting($14)::bigint
  ) AS v
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- databases: include XID wraparound age for v_wrap detection
databases AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $15,              datname,
    $16,             pg_get_userbyid(datdba),
    $17,          pg_encoding_to_char(encoding),
    $18,           datcollate,
    $19,             datctype,
    $20,        pg_database_size(datname),
    $21,         datconnlimit,
    $22,       datistemplate,
    $23,        datallowconn,
    $24,      datfrozenxid::text,
    $25,           age(datfrozenxid),
    $26,       round($27 * age(datfrozenxid)
                           / NULLIF(current_setting($28)::bigint, $29), $30)
  ) ORDER BY datname) AS v
  FROM pg_database
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
schemas AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $31,  nspname,
    $32, pg_get_userbyid(nspowner)
  ) ORDER BY nspname) AS v
  FROM pg_namespace
  WHERE nspname NOT LIKE $33
    AND nspname NOT LIKE $34
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
extensions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $35,         extname,
    $36,      extversion,
    $37,       n.nspname,
    $38,  extrelocatable
  ) ORDER BY extname) AS v
  FROM pg_extension e
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = e.extnamespace
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tablespaces AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $39,       spcname,
    $40,      pg_get_userbyid(spcowner),
    $41,   pg_tablespace_location(oid),
    $42, pg_tablespace_size(oid)
  ) ORDER BY spcname) AS v
  FROM pg_tablespace
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tables: include relpages + relfrozenxid (needed for bloat formula + wraparound)
tables AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $43,          t.schemaname,
    $44,           t.tablename,
    $45,           t.tableowner,
    $46,      t.tablespace,
    $47,     pg_total_relation_size(t.schemaname || $48 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $49,     pg_relation_size(t.schemaname || $50 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $51,     pg_indexes_size(t.schemaname || $52 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $53,     COALESCE(
                         pg_total_relation_size(t.schemaname || $54 || quote_ident(t.tablename))
                         - pg_relation_size(t.schemaname || $55 || quote_ident(t.tablename))
                         - pg_indexes_size(t.schemaname || $56 || quote_ident(t.tablename)), $57),
    $58,    c.reltuples::bigint,
    $59,        c.relpages,
    $60,   c.relallvisible,
    $61,    c.relfrozenxid::text,
    $62,   age(c.relfrozenxid),
    $63,         c.relkind::text,
    $64,  c.relpersistence::text,
    $65,  c.relhastriggers,
    $66,     c.relhasindex,
    $67,      (SELECT (regexp_match(c.reloptions::text, $68))[$69]::int)
  ) ORDER BY t.schemaname, t.tablename) AS v
  FROM pg_tables t
  JOIN pg_class c      ON c.relname = t.tablename
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = t.schemaname
  WHERE t.schemaname NOT IN ($70, $71, $72)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- columns: full type info + alignment/length for padding waste analysis
columns AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $73,        n.nspname,
    $74,         c.relname,
    $75,        a.attname,
    $76,      a.attnum,
    $77,     t.typname,
    $78, t.typcategory::text,
    $79,        a.attlen,        -- -1 = variable length
    $80,      a.attalign::text, -- c=1B, s=2B, i=4B, d=8B
    $81,    a.attstorage::text, -- p=plain, e=external, m=main, x=extended
    $82,    a.attnotnull,
    $83,      a.attndims,
    $84,     a.atthasdef,
    $85,   a.attidentity::text,
    $86,  a.attgenerated::text,
    $87,     a.atttypmod,     -- type modifier (e.g. varchar(N))
    $88,      CASE a.attlen
                       WHEN $89 THEN $90
                       ELSE a.attlen::text || $91
                     END,
    $92,   CASE a.attalign
                       WHEN $93 THEN $94
                       WHEN $95 THEN $96
                       WHEN $97 THEN $98
                       WHEN $99 THEN $100
                       ELSE $101
                     END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum) AS v
  FROM pg_attribute a
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = a.attrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_type t      ON t.oid = a.atttypid
  WHERE a.attnum > $102
    AND NOT a.attisdropped
    AND n.nspname NOT IN ($103, $104, $105)
    AND c.relkind IN ($106, $107)  -- regular tables and partitioned tables only
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
indexes AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $108,       schemaname,
    $109,        tablename,
    $110,   indexname,
    $111,   tablespace,
    $112,    indexdef,
    $113,   pg_relation_size(schemaname || $114 || quote_ident(indexname)),
    $115,    ix.indisunique,
    $116,   ix.indisprimary,
    $117, ix.indisexclusion,
    $118,     ix.indisvalid,
    $119,     ix.indisready,
    $120,     array_length(ix.indkey, $121),
    $122,       ix.indkey::int2[]::text,  -- column positions (for dup detection)
    $123,     ix.indclass::int4[]::text,
    $124,    ix.indoption::int2[]::text,
    $125,    ix.indexprs IS NOT NULL,
    $126,     ix.indpred IS NOT NULL
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, indexname) AS v
  FROM pg_indexes i
  JOIN pg_class c    ON c.relname = indexname
  JOIN pg_index ix   ON ix.indexrelid = c.oid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($127, $128)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- constraints: include conkey (column positions) for unindexed FK detection
constraints AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $129,        n.nspname,
    $130,         cl.relname,
    $131,          conname,
    $132,          CASE contype
                       WHEN $133 THEN $134
                       WHEN $135 THEN $136
                       WHEN $137 THEN $138
                       WHEN $139 THEN $140
                       WHEN $141 THEN $142
                       WHEN $143 THEN $144
                       ELSE contype::text END,
    $145, condeferrable,
    $146,   condeferred,
    $147,  convalidated,
    $148,        conkey::text,   -- local column positions
    $149,       confkey::text,  -- referenced column positions
    $150,      array_length(conkey, $151),
    $152,     fn.nspname,
    $153,      fc.relname
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, cl.relname, conname) AS v
  FROM pg_constraint co
  JOIN pg_class     cl ON cl.oid = co.conrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = cl.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_class     fc ON fc.oid = co.confrelid
  LEFT JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($154, $155)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- unindexed_fks: pre-computed (mirrors v_fk_unindexed in ultimate_report)
unindexed_fks AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $156,  n1.nspname,
    $157,   c1.relname,
    $158,  a1.attname,
    $159, t.conname,
    $160, fn.nspname || $161 || fc.relname
  ) ORDER BY n1.nspname, c1.relname) AS v
  FROM pg_constraint t
  JOIN pg_attribute  a1 ON a1.attrelid = t.conrelid AND a1.attnum = t.conkey[$162]
  JOIN pg_class      c1 ON c1.oid = t.conrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace  n1 ON n1.oid = c1.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_class     fc ON fc.oid = t.confrelid
  LEFT JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
  WHERE t.contype = $163
    AND n1.nspname NOT IN ($164, $165)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT $166 FROM pg_index i
      WHERE i.indrelid = t.conrelid
        AND i.indkey[$167] = t.conkey[$168]
    )
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sequences AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $169,        n.nspname,
    $170,          c.relname,
    $171,     t.typname,
    $172,         s.seqstart,
    $173,     s.seqincrement,
    $174,           s.seqmin,
    $175,           s.seqmax,
    $176,         s.seqcache,
    $177,         s.seqcycle,
    $178,    ps.last_value,
    $179, CASE WHEN s.seqmax > s.seqmin
                       THEN round($180 * (
                         COALESCE(ps.last_value, s.seqmin) - s.seqmin
                       ) / NULLIF(s.seqmax - s.seqmin, $181), $182)
                     END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname) AS v
  FROM pg_sequence s
  JOIN pg_class c      ON c.oid = s.seqrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_type t       ON t.oid = s.seqtypid
  LEFT JOIN pg_sequences ps ON ps.schemaname = n.nspname AND ps.sequencename = c.relname
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($183, $184)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
views AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $185,         table_schema,
    $186,           table_name,
    $187,   is_updatable = $188,
    $189,  is_insertable_into = $190
  ) ORDER BY table_schema, table_name) AS v
  FROM information_schema.views
  WHERE table_schema NOT IN ($191, $192)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
functions_summary AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $193,     count(*),
    $194, json_object_agg(lanname, cnt)
  ) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT l.lanname, count(*) AS cnt
    FROM pg_proc p
    JOIN pg_language l  ON l.oid = p.prolang
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
    WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($195, $196)
    GROUP BY l.lanname
  ) sub
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- roles: include password hash TYPE (not value) for security audit
roles AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $197,         rolname,
    $198,    rolsuper,
    $199,      rolinherit,
    $200,   rolcreaterole,
    $201,     rolcreatedb,
    $202,        rolcanlogin,
    $203,  rolreplication,
    $204,    rolbypassrls,
    $205,    rolconnlimit,
    $206,  rolvaliduntil,
    $207, rolpassword IS NOT NULL,
    $208,     CASE
                      WHEN rolpassword IS NULL       THEN $209
                      WHEN rolpassword LIKE $210 THEN $211
                      WHEN rolpassword LIKE $212   THEN $213
                      ELSE $214
                    END,
    $215,   CASE
                      WHEN rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication THEN $216
                      WHEN rolpassword IS NULL AND rolcanlogin THEN $217
                      ELSE $218
                    END
  ) ORDER BY rolname) AS v
  FROM pg_roles
  WHERE rolname NOT LIKE $219
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- settings: complete set used by audit checks
settings_key AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $220,     name,
    $221,  setting,
    $222,     unit,
    $223,   source,
    $224,  min_val,
    $225,  max_val
  ) ORDER BY name) AS v
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    $226,$227,$228,$229,
    $230,$231,$232,$233,
    $234,$235,
    $236,$237,$238,
    $239,$240,$241,
    $242,$243,$244,
    $245,$246,$247,$248,
    $249,$250,$251,
    $252,$253,$254,
    $255,$256,$257,
    $258,$259,$260,$261,
    $262,$263,$264,
    $265,$266,$267,
    $268,$269
  )
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pg_stats: planner column statistics — used by bloat formula in ultimate_report
-- (null_frac, avg_width per column; NOT actual data values)
planner_stats AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $270,        schemaname,
    $271,         tablename,
    $272,        attname,
    $273,     inherited,
    $274,     round(null_frac::numeric, $275),
    $276,     avg_width,
    $277,    n_distinct,
    $278,   round(correlation::numeric, $279),
    $280, array_length(most_common_freqs, $281),
    $282,  array_length(histogram_bounds, $283)
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, attname) AS v
  FROM pg_stats
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($284, $285)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- bloat_pre_computed: same formula as v_bloat in ultimate_report.sql
bloat_computed AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $286,      schemaname,
    $287,       tablename,
    $288,    relpages,
    $289,        otta,
    $290,      round((CASE WHEN otta = $291 THEN $292
                          ELSE relpages::float / NULLIF(otta, $293) END)::numeric, $294),
    $295,GREATEST(relpages - otta, $296),
    $297, GREATEST(relpages - otta, $298) * current_setting($299)::int
  ) ORDER BY GREATEST(relpages - otta, $300) DESC NULLS LAST) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT schemaname, tablename, cc.relpages,
      CEIL((cc.reltuples * $301) / NULLIF(current_setting($302)::int - $303, $304))::bigint AS otta
    FROM pg_stats s
    JOIN pg_class cc     ON cc.relname = s.tablename
    JOIN pg_namespace nn ON cc.relnamespace = nn.oid AND nn.nspname = s.schemaname
    WHERE s.schemaname NOT IN ($305, $306)
    GROUP BY schemaname, tablename, cc.relpages, cc.reltuples
  ) foo
  WHERE relpages > otta
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- available extensions (for extension audit)
available_extensions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $307,              name,
    $308,   default_version,
    $309, installed_version,
    $310,           comment
  ) ORDER BY name) AS v
  FROM pg_available_extensions
  WHERE installed_version IS NOT NULL
     OR name IN ($311,$312,$313,
                 $314,$315,$316,$317,$318)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- functions: per-function / procedure detail
functions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $319,           n.nspname,
    $320,             p.proname,
    $321,         l.lanname,
    $322,             CASE p.prokind
                          WHEN $323 THEN $324
                          WHEN $325 THEN $326
                          WHEN $327 THEN $328
                          WHEN $329 THEN $330
                          ELSE p.prokind::text END,
    $331,      CASE WHEN p.prokind = $332 THEN $333
                             ELSE pg_get_function_result(p.oid) END,
    $334,        pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
    $335,       CASE p.provolatile
                          WHEN $336 THEN $337
                          WHEN $338 THEN $339
                          WHEN $340 THEN $341 END,
    $342, p.prosecdef,
    $343,           p.proisstrict,
    $344,         CASE p.proparallel
                          WHEN $345 THEN $346
                          WHEN $347 THEN $348
                          WHEN $349 THEN $350 END,
    $351,             p.procost,
    $352,             p.prorows,
    $353,       CASE WHEN l.lanname NOT IN ($354, $355)
                               THEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
                             ELSE $356 END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid)) AS v
  FROM pg_proc p
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
  JOIN pg_language l  ON l.oid = p.prolang
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($357, $358)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- triggers: per-trigger detail
triggers AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $359,           n.nspname,
    $360,            c.relname,
    $361,     t.tgname,
    $362,          t.tgenabled <> $363,
    $364,           CASE
                          WHEN (t.tgtype &  $365) <> $366 THEN $367
                          WHEN (t.tgtype & $368) <> $369 THEN $370
                          ELSE $371 END,
    $372,           array_remove(ARRAY[
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype &  $373) <> $374 THEN $375   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype &  $376) <> $377 THEN $378   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $379) <> $380 THEN $381   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $382) <> $383 THEN $384 END
                        ], $385),
    $386,      CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $387) <> $388 THEN $389 ELSE $390 END,
    $391,  fn.nspname,
    $392,    p.proname,
    $393,        pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid)
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname) AS v
  FROM pg_trigger t
  JOIN pg_class c       ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n   ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_proc p        ON p.oid = t.tgfoid
  JOIN pg_namespace fn  ON fn.oid = p.pronamespace
  WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
    AND n.nspname NOT IN ($394, $395)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mat_views: materialized views
mat_views AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $396,       schemaname,
    $397,         matviewname,
    $398,        matviewowner,
    $399,   tablespace,
    $400, ispopulated,
    $401,   definition
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, matviewname) AS v
  FROM pg_matviews
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($402, $403)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- policies: row-level security policies
policies AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $404,       n.nspname,
    $405,        c.relname,
    $406,         p.polname,
    $407,   p.polpermissive,
    $408,        CASE
                      WHEN p.polroles = $409::oid[] THEN ARRAY[$410]
                      ELSE ARRAY(SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles r
                                 WHERE r.oid = ANY(p.polroles))
                    END,
    $411,          CASE p.polcmd
                      WHEN $412 THEN $413
                      WHEN $414 THEN $415
                      WHEN $416 THEN $417
                      WHEN $418 THEN $419
                      WHEN $420 THEN $421
                    END,
    $422,         pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid),
    $423,   pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid),
    $424,  c.relrowsecurity,
    $425,   c.relforcerowsecurity
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname) AS v
  FROM pg_policy p
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = p.polrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($426, $427)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- rules: rewrite rules on tables/views (excluding default view return rules)
-- pg_rules only has schemaname/tablename/rulename/definition; event and
-- do_instead come from pg_rewrite (ev_type, is_instead).
rules AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $428,     n.nspname,
    $429,      c.relname,
    $430,  r.rulename,
    $431,      CASE r.ev_type
                    WHEN $432 THEN $433
                    WHEN $434 THEN $435
                    WHEN $436 THEN $437
                    WHEN $438 THEN $439
                    ELSE r.ev_type::text END,
    $440, r.is_instead,
    $441, pg_get_ruledef(r.oid)
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, r.rulename) AS v
  FROM pg_rewrite r
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = r.ev_class
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($442, $443)
    AND r.rulename <> $444
)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT json_build_object(
  $445,               (SELECT v FROM meta),
  $446,           (SELECT v FROM databases),
  $447,             (SELECT v FROM schemas),
  $448,          (SELECT v FROM extensions),
  $449,(SELECT v FROM available_extensions),
  $450,         (SELECT v FROM tablespaces),
  $451,              (SELECT v FROM tables),
  $452,             (SELECT v FROM columns),
  $453,             (SELECT v FROM indexes),
  $454,         (SELECT v FROM constraints),
  $455,       (SELECT v FROM unindexed_fks),
  $456,           (SELECT v FROM sequences),
  $457,               (SELECT v FROM views),
  $458,   (SELECT v FROM functions_summary),
  $459,               (SELECT v FROM roles),
  $460,        (SELECT v FROM settings_key),
  $461,       (SELECT v FROM planner_stats),
  $462,      (SELECT v FROM bloat_computed),
  $463,           (SELECT v FROM functions),
  $464,            (SELECT v FROM triggers),
  $465,           (SELECT v FROM mat_views),
  $466,            (SELECT v FROM policies),
  $467,               (SELECT v FROM rules)
)

WITH
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $1,               $2,
    $3,            $4,
    $5,       now(),
    $6,         version(),
    $7,     current_setting($8)::int,
    $9,           current_database(),
    $10,    pg_encoding_to_char(
                            (SELECT encoding FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database())),
    $11,         current_setting($12)::int,
    $13, current_setting($14)::bigint
  ) AS v
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- databases: include XID wraparound age for v_wrap detection
databases AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $15,              datname,
    $16,             pg_get_userbyid(datdba),
    $17,          pg_encoding_to_char(encoding),
    $18,           datcollate,
    $19,             datctype,
    $20,        pg_database_size(datname),
    $21,         datconnlimit,
    $22,       datistemplate,
    $23,        datallowconn,
    $24,      datfrozenxid::text,
    $25,           age(datfrozenxid),
    $26,       round($27 * age(datfrozenxid)
                           / NULLIF(current_setting($28)::bigint, $29), $30)
  ) ORDER BY datname) AS v
  FROM pg_database
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
schemas AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $31,  nspname,
    $32, pg_get_userbyid(nspowner)
  ) ORDER BY nspname) AS v
  FROM pg_namespace
  WHERE nspname NOT LIKE $33
    AND nspname NOT LIKE $34
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
extensions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $35,         extname,
    $36,      extversion,
    $37,       n.nspname,
    $38,  extrelocatable
  ) ORDER BY extname) AS v
  FROM pg_extension e
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = e.extnamespace
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
tablespaces AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $39,       spcname,
    $40,      pg_get_userbyid(spcowner),
    $41,   pg_tablespace_location(oid),
    $42, pg_tablespace_size(oid)
  ) ORDER BY spcname) AS v
  FROM pg_tablespace
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- tables: include relpages + relfrozenxid (needed for bloat formula + wraparound)
tables AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $43,          t.schemaname,
    $44,           t.tablename,
    $45,           t.tableowner,
    $46,      t.tablespace,
    $47,     pg_total_relation_size(t.schemaname || $48 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $49,     pg_relation_size(t.schemaname || $50 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $51,     pg_indexes_size(t.schemaname || $52 || quote_ident(t.tablename)),
    $53,     COALESCE(
                         pg_total_relation_size(t.schemaname || $54 || quote_ident(t.tablename))
                         - pg_relation_size(t.schemaname || $55 || quote_ident(t.tablename))
                         - pg_indexes_size(t.schemaname || $56 || quote_ident(t.tablename)), $57),
    $58,    c.reltuples::bigint,
    $59,        c.relpages,
    $60,   c.relallvisible,
    $61,    c.relfrozenxid::text,
    $62,   age(c.relfrozenxid),
    $63,         c.relkind::text,
    $64,  c.relpersistence::text,
    $65,  c.relhastriggers,
    $66,     c.relhasindex,
    $67,      (SELECT (regexp_match(c.reloptions::text, $68))[$69]::int)
  ) ORDER BY t.schemaname, t.tablename) AS v
  FROM pg_tables t
  JOIN pg_class c      ON c.relname = t.tablename
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = t.schemaname
  WHERE t.schemaname NOT IN ($70, $71, $72)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- columns: full type info + alignment/length for padding waste analysis
columns AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $73,        n.nspname,
    $74,         c.relname,
    $75,        a.attname,
    $76,      a.attnum,
    $77,     t.typname,
    $78, t.typcategory::text,
    $79,        a.attlen,        -- -1 = variable length
    $80,      a.attalign::text, -- c=1B, s=2B, i=4B, d=8B
    $81,    a.attstorage::text, -- p=plain, e=external, m=main, x=extended
    $82,    a.attnotnull,
    $83,      a.attndims,
    $84,     a.atthasdef,
    $85,   a.attidentity::text,
    $86,  a.attgenerated::text,
    $87,     a.atttypmod,     -- type modifier (e.g. varchar(N))
    $88,      CASE a.attlen
                       WHEN $89 THEN $90
                       ELSE a.attlen::text || $91
                     END,
    $92,   CASE a.attalign
                       WHEN $93 THEN $94
                       WHEN $95 THEN $96
                       WHEN $97 THEN $98
                       WHEN $99 THEN $100
                       ELSE $101
                     END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum) AS v
  FROM pg_attribute a
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = a.attrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_type t      ON t.oid = a.atttypid
  WHERE a.attnum > $102
    AND NOT a.attisdropped
    AND n.nspname NOT IN ($103, $104, $105)
    AND c.relkind IN ($106, $107)  -- regular tables and partitioned tables only
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
indexes AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $108,       schemaname,
    $109,        tablename,
    $110,   indexname,
    $111,   tablespace,
    $112,    indexdef,
    $113,   pg_relation_size(schemaname || $114 || quote_ident(indexname)),
    $115,    ix.indisunique,
    $116,   ix.indisprimary,
    $117, ix.indisexclusion,
    $118,     ix.indisvalid,
    $119,     ix.indisready,
    $120,     array_length(ix.indkey, $121),
    $122,       ix.indkey::int2[]::text,  -- column positions (for dup detection)
    $123,     ix.indclass::int4[]::text,
    $124,    ix.indoption::int2[]::text,
    $125,    ix.indexprs IS NOT NULL,
    $126,     ix.indpred IS NOT NULL
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, indexname) AS v
  FROM pg_indexes i
  JOIN pg_class c    ON c.relname = indexname
  JOIN pg_index ix   ON ix.indexrelid = c.oid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($127, $128)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- constraints: include conkey (column positions) for unindexed FK detection
constraints AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $129,        n.nspname,
    $130,         cl.relname,
    $131,          conname,
    $132,          CASE contype
                       WHEN $133 THEN $134
                       WHEN $135 THEN $136
                       WHEN $137 THEN $138
                       WHEN $139 THEN $140
                       WHEN $141 THEN $142
                       WHEN $143 THEN $144
                       ELSE contype::text END,
    $145, condeferrable,
    $146,   condeferred,
    $147,  convalidated,
    $148,        conkey::text,   -- local column positions
    $149,       confkey::text,  -- referenced column positions
    $150,      array_length(conkey, $151),
    $152,     fn.nspname,
    $153,      fc.relname
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, cl.relname, conname) AS v
  FROM pg_constraint co
  JOIN pg_class     cl ON cl.oid = co.conrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = cl.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_class     fc ON fc.oid = co.confrelid
  LEFT JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($154, $155)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- unindexed_fks: pre-computed (mirrors v_fk_unindexed in ultimate_report)
unindexed_fks AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $156,  n1.nspname,
    $157,   c1.relname,
    $158,  a1.attname,
    $159, t.conname,
    $160, fn.nspname || $161 || fc.relname
  ) ORDER BY n1.nspname, c1.relname) AS v
  FROM pg_constraint t
  JOIN pg_attribute  a1 ON a1.attrelid = t.conrelid AND a1.attnum = t.conkey[$162]
  JOIN pg_class      c1 ON c1.oid = t.conrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace  n1 ON n1.oid = c1.relnamespace
  LEFT JOIN pg_class     fc ON fc.oid = t.confrelid
  LEFT JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace
  WHERE t.contype = $163
    AND n1.nspname NOT IN ($164, $165)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT $166 FROM pg_index i
      WHERE i.indrelid = t.conrelid
        AND i.indkey[$167] = t.conkey[$168]
    )
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sequences AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $169,        n.nspname,
    $170,          c.relname,
    $171,     t.typname,
    $172,         s.seqstart,
    $173,     s.seqincrement,
    $174,           s.seqmin,
    $175,           s.seqmax,
    $176,         s.seqcache,
    $177,         s.seqcycle,
    $178,    ps.last_value,
    $179, CASE WHEN s.seqmax > s.seqmin
                       THEN round($180 * (
                         COALESCE(ps.last_value, s.seqmin) - s.seqmin
                       ) / NULLIF(s.seqmax - s.seqmin, $181), $182)
                     END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname) AS v
  FROM pg_sequence s
  JOIN pg_class c      ON c.oid = s.seqrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n  ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_type t       ON t.oid = s.seqtypid
  LEFT JOIN pg_sequences ps ON ps.schemaname = n.nspname AND ps.sequencename = c.relname
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($183, $184)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
views AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $185,         table_schema,
    $186,           table_name,
    $187,   is_updatable = $188,
    $189,  is_insertable_into = $190
  ) ORDER BY table_schema, table_name) AS v
  FROM information_schema.views
  WHERE table_schema NOT IN ($191, $192)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
functions_summary AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $193,     count(*),
    $194, json_object_agg(lanname, cnt)
  ) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT l.lanname, count(*) AS cnt
    FROM pg_proc p
    JOIN pg_language l  ON l.oid = p.prolang
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
    WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($195, $196)
    GROUP BY l.lanname
  ) sub
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- roles: include password hash TYPE (not value) for security audit
roles AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $197,         rolname,
    $198,    rolsuper,
    $199,      rolinherit,
    $200,   rolcreaterole,
    $201,     rolcreatedb,
    $202,        rolcanlogin,
    $203,  rolreplication,
    $204,    rolbypassrls,
    $205,    rolconnlimit,
    $206,  rolvaliduntil,
    $207, rolpassword IS NOT NULL,
    $208,     CASE
                      WHEN rolpassword IS NULL       THEN $209
                      WHEN rolpassword LIKE $210 THEN $211
                      WHEN rolpassword LIKE $212   THEN $213
                      ELSE $214
                    END,
    $215,   CASE
                      WHEN rolsuper OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication THEN $216
                      WHEN rolpassword IS NULL AND rolcanlogin THEN $217
                      ELSE $218
                    END
  ) ORDER BY rolname) AS v
  FROM pg_roles
  WHERE rolname NOT LIKE $219
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- settings: complete set used by audit checks
settings_key AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $220,     name,
    $221,  setting,
    $222,     unit,
    $223,   source,
    $224,  min_val,
    $225,  max_val
  ) ORDER BY name) AS v
  FROM pg_settings
  WHERE name IN (
    $226,$227,$228,$229,
    $230,$231,$232,$233,
    $234,$235,
    $236,$237,$238,
    $239,$240,$241,
    $242,$243,$244,
    $245,$246,$247,$248,
    $249,$250,$251,
    $252,$253,$254,
    $255,$256,$257,
    $258,$259,$260,$261,
    $262,$263,$264,
    $265,$266,$267,
    $268,$269
  )
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pg_stats: planner column statistics — used by bloat formula in ultimate_report
-- (null_frac, avg_width per column; NOT actual data values)
planner_stats AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $270,        schemaname,
    $271,         tablename,
    $272,        attname,
    $273,     inherited,
    $274,     round(null_frac::numeric, $275),
    $276,     avg_width,
    $277,    n_distinct,
    $278,   round(correlation::numeric, $279),
    $280, array_length(most_common_freqs, $281),
    $282,  array_length(histogram_bounds, $283)
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, tablename, attname) AS v
  FROM pg_stats
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($284, $285)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- bloat_pre_computed: same formula as v_bloat in ultimate_report.sql
bloat_computed AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $286,      schemaname,
    $287,       tablename,
    $288,    relpages,
    $289,        otta,
    $290,      round((CASE WHEN otta = $291 THEN $292
                          ELSE relpages::float / NULLIF(otta, $293) END)::numeric, $294),
    $295,GREATEST(relpages - otta, $296),
    $297, GREATEST(relpages - otta, $298) * current_setting($299)::int
  ) ORDER BY GREATEST(relpages - otta, $300) DESC NULLS LAST) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT schemaname, tablename, cc.relpages,
      CEIL((cc.reltuples * $301) / NULLIF(current_setting($302)::int - $303, $304))::bigint AS otta
    FROM pg_stats s
    JOIN pg_class cc     ON cc.relname = s.tablename
    JOIN pg_namespace nn ON cc.relnamespace = nn.oid AND nn.nspname = s.schemaname
    WHERE s.schemaname NOT IN ($305, $306)
    GROUP BY schemaname, tablename, cc.relpages, cc.reltuples
  ) foo
  WHERE relpages > otta
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- available extensions (for extension audit)
available_extensions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $307,              name,
    $308,   default_version,
    $309, installed_version,
    $310,           comment
  ) ORDER BY name) AS v
  FROM pg_available_extensions
  WHERE installed_version IS NOT NULL
     OR name IN ($311,$312,$313,
                 $314,$315,$316,$317,$318)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- functions: per-function / procedure detail
functions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $319,           n.nspname,
    $320,             p.proname,
    $321,         l.lanname,
    $322,             CASE p.prokind
                          WHEN $323 THEN $324
                          WHEN $325 THEN $326
                          WHEN $327 THEN $328
                          WHEN $329 THEN $330
                          ELSE p.prokind::text END,
    $331,      CASE WHEN p.prokind = $332 THEN $333
                             ELSE pg_get_function_result(p.oid) END,
    $334,        pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid),
    $335,       CASE p.provolatile
                          WHEN $336 THEN $337
                          WHEN $338 THEN $339
                          WHEN $340 THEN $341 END,
    $342, p.prosecdef,
    $343,           p.proisstrict,
    $344,         CASE p.proparallel
                          WHEN $345 THEN $346
                          WHEN $347 THEN $348
                          WHEN $349 THEN $350 END,
    $351,             p.procost,
    $352,             p.prorows,
    $353,       CASE WHEN l.lanname NOT IN ($354, $355)
                               THEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
                             ELSE $356 END
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid)) AS v
  FROM pg_proc p
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
  JOIN pg_language l  ON l.oid = p.prolang
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($357, $358)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- triggers: per-trigger detail
triggers AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $359,           n.nspname,
    $360,            c.relname,
    $361,     t.tgname,
    $362,          t.tgenabled <> $363,
    $364,           CASE
                          WHEN (t.tgtype &  $365) <> $366 THEN $367
                          WHEN (t.tgtype & $368) <> $369 THEN $370
                          ELSE $371 END,
    $372,           array_remove(ARRAY[
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype &  $373) <> $374 THEN $375   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype &  $376) <> $377 THEN $378   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $379) <> $380 THEN $381   END,
                          CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $382) <> $383 THEN $384 END
                        ], $385),
    $386,      CASE WHEN (t.tgtype & $387) <> $388 THEN $389 ELSE $390 END,
    $391,  fn.nspname,
    $392,    p.proname,
    $393,        pg_get_expr(t.tgqual, t.tgrelid)
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname) AS v
  FROM pg_trigger t
  JOIN pg_class c       ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n   ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  JOIN pg_proc p        ON p.oid = t.tgfoid
  JOIN pg_namespace fn  ON fn.oid = p.pronamespace
  WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
    AND n.nspname NOT IN ($394, $395)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- mat_views: materialized views
mat_views AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $396,       schemaname,
    $397,         matviewname,
    $398,        matviewowner,
    $399,   tablespace,
    $400, ispopulated,
    $401,   definition
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, matviewname) AS v
  FROM pg_matviews
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($402, $403)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- policies: row-level security policies
policies AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $404,       n.nspname,
    $405,        c.relname,
    $406,         p.polname,
    $407,   p.polpermissive,
    $408,        CASE
                      WHEN p.polroles = $409::oid[] THEN ARRAY[$410]
                      ELSE ARRAY(SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles r
                                 WHERE r.oid = ANY(p.polroles))
                    END,
    $411,          CASE p.polcmd
                      WHEN $412 THEN $413
                      WHEN $414 THEN $415
                      WHEN $416 THEN $417
                      WHEN $418 THEN $419
                      WHEN $420 THEN $421
                    END,
    $422,         pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid),
    $423,   pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid),
    $424,  c.relrowsecurity,
    $425,   c.relforcerowsecurity
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, p.polname) AS v
  FROM pg_policy p
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = p.polrelid
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($426, $427)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- rules: rewrite rules on tables/views (excluding default view return rules)
-- pg_rules only has schemaname/tablename/rulename/definition; event and
-- do_instead come from pg_rewrite (ev_type, is_instead).
rules AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $428,     n.nspname,
    $429,      c.relname,
    $430,  r.rulename,
    $431,      CASE r.ev_type
                    WHEN $432 THEN $433
                    WHEN $434 THEN $435
                    WHEN $436 THEN $437
                    WHEN $438 THEN $439
                    ELSE r.ev_type::text END,
    $440, r.is_instead,
    $441, pg_get_ruledef(r.oid)
  ) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, r.rulename) AS v
  FROM pg_rewrite r
  JOIN pg_class c     ON c.oid = r.ev_class
  JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($442, $443)
    AND r.rulename <> $444
)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT json_build_object(
  $445,               (SELECT v FROM meta),
  $446,           (SELECT v FROM databases),
  $447,             (SELECT v FROM schemas),
  $448,          (SELECT v FROM extensions),
  $449,(SELECT v FROM available_extensions),
  $450,         (SELECT v FROM tablespaces),
  $451,              (SELECT v FROM tables),
  $452,             (SELECT v FROM columns),
  $453,             (SELECT v FROM indexes),
  $454,         (SELECT v FROM constraints),
  $455,       (SELECT v FROM unindexed_fks),
  $456,           (SELECT v FROM sequences),
  $457,               (SELECT v FROM views),
  $458,   (SELECT v FROM functions_summary),
  $459,               (SELECT v FROM roles),
  $460,        (SELECT v FROM settings_key),
  $461,       (SELECT v FROM planner_stats),
  $462,      (SELECT v FROM bloat_computed),
  $463,           (SELECT v FROM functions),
  $464,            (SELECT v FROM triggers),
  $465,           (SELECT v FROM mat_views),
  $466,            (SELECT v FROM policies),
  $467,               (SELECT v FROM rules)
)
UPDATE sales.orders SET status=$1 WHERE id % $2 = $3
SELECT p.method, sum(i.amount_cents) FROM billing.payments p JOIN billing.invoices i ON i.id = p.invoice_id GROUP BY p.method
SELECT c.country, count(*) FROM sales.customers c JOIN sales.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.order_items WHERE sku LIKE $1
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_stat_statements
SELECT count(*) FROM sales.orders WHERE status = $1

WITH
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $1,              $2,
    $3,           $4,
    $5,      now(),
    $6,        version(),
    $7,    current_setting($8)::int,
    $9,          current_database(),
    $10,         now() - pg_postmaster_start_time(),
    $11,(SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_bgwriter),
    -- Cluster role: mirrors pg_is_in_recovery() used by v_repl in ultimate_report
    $12,    pg_is_in_recovery(),
    $13,      CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery() THEN $14 ELSE $15 END,
    $16,   pg_current_wal_lsn()::text
  ) AS v
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pg_stat_statements — 5 version branches (PG12 / PG13 / PG14 / PG15-16 / PG17+)
--   PG12: total_time/mean_time/stddev_time, blk_read_time, no plan/wal/jit
--   PG13: +exec suffix rename, +wal_records/wal_bytes, +plan/mean_plan_time/plans
--   PG14: +jit_functions/generation_time, +toplevel (basic JIT only)
--   PG15-16: +jit_inlining/optimization/emission_time (extended JIT)
--   PG17+: shared_blk_read_time + local/temp variants, +stats_since
-- Outer \if :has_pss guard prevents parse-time "relation does not exist" errors
-- when the extension is not loaded (CASE WHEN EXISTS is a runtime check only).
-- pg_stat_statements extension not installed
stat_statements AS (
  SELECT $17::json AS v
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- n_ins_since_vacuum added in PG13; use \if branch to avoid parse-time column error
stat_tables AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $18,              schemaname,
    $19,               relname,
    $20,            seq_scan,
    $21,        seq_tup_read,
    $22,            idx_scan,
    $23,       idx_tup_fetch,
    $24,           n_tup_ins,
    $25,           n_tup_upd,
    $26,           n_tup_del,
    $27,       n_tup_hot_upd,
    $28,          n_live_tup,
    $29,          n_dead_tup,
    $30, n_mod_since_analyze,
    $31,  n_ins_since_vacuum,
    $32,         last_vacuum,
    $33,     last_autovacuum,
    $34,        last_analyze,
    $35,    last_autoanalyze,
    $36,        vacuum_count,
    $37,    autovacuum_count,
    $38,       analyze_count,
    $39,   autoanalyze_count
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, relname) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_all_tables
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($40, $41)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
statio_tables AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $42,            schemaname,
    $43,             relname,
    $44,    heap_blks_read,
    $45,     heap_blks_hit,
    $46,     idx_blks_read,
    $47,      idx_blks_hit,
    $48,   toast_blks_read,
    $49,    toast_blks_hit,
    $50,    tidx_blks_read,
    $51,     tidx_blks_hit,
    $52,   CASE WHEN (heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit) > $53
                           THEN round($54 * heap_blks_hit / (heap_blks_read + heap_blks_hit), $55)
                         END
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, relname) AS v
  FROM pg_statio_all_tables
  WHERE schemaname NOT IN ($56, $57)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
stat_indexes AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $58,        schemaname,
    $59,         relname,
    $60,         indexrelname,
    $61,      idx_scan,
    $62,  idx_tup_read,
    $63, idx_tup_fetch,
    $64,    pg_relation_size(si.indexrelid),
    $65,     ix.indisunique,
    $66,    ix.indisprimary,
    $67,      ix.indisvalid
  ) ORDER BY schemaname, relname, indexrelname) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_user_indexes si
  JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = si.indexrelid
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pg_stat_bgwriter: PG17 split bgwriter — checkpointer stats moved to
-- pg_stat_checkpointer. psql \if selects the right branch at parse time.
stat_bgwriter AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $68,          $69,
    $70,       b.buffers_clean,
    $71,    b.maxwritten_clean,
    $72,       b.buffers_alloc,
    $73,         b.stats_reset,
    $74,   c.num_timed,
    $75,     c.num_requested,
    $76, c.write_time,
    $77,  c.sync_time,
    $78,  c.buffers_written,
    $79,  c.stats_reset
  ) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_bgwriter b, pg_stat_checkpointer c
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
stat_database AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $80,         datname,
    $81,     numbackends,
    $82,     xact_commit,
    $83,   xact_rollback,
    $84,       blks_read,
    $85,        blks_hit,
    $86, CASE WHEN (blks_read + blks_hit) > $87
                         THEN round($88 * blks_hit / (blks_read + blks_hit), $89)
                       END,
    $90,    tup_returned,
    $91,     tup_fetched,
    $92,    tup_inserted,
    $93,     tup_updated,
    $94,     tup_deleted,
    $95,       conflicts,
    $96,      temp_files,
    $97,      temp_bytes,
    $98,       deadlocks,
    $99, checksum_failures,
    $100,   round(blk_read_time::numeric, $101),
    $102,  round(blk_write_time::numeric, $103),
    $104,     stats_reset
  ) ORDER BY datname) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_database
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
stat_replication AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $105, application_name,
    $106,     client_addr,
    $107,           state,
    $108,        sent_lsn,
    $109,       write_lsn,
    $110,       flush_lsn,
    $111,      replay_lsn,
    $112,       write_lag,
    $113,       flush_lag,
    $114,      replay_lag,
    $115,      sync_state,
    $116,   backend_start
  ) ORDER BY client_addr) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_replication
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
replication_slots AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $117,      slot_name,
    $118,         plugin,
    $119,      slot_type,
    $120,       database,
    $121,         active,
    $122,     active_pid,
    $123,           xmin,
    $124,   catalog_xmin,
    $125,    restart_lsn,
    $126, confirmed_flush_lsn,
    $127,  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), restart_lsn),
    $128,      temporary
  ) ORDER BY slot_name) AS v
  FROM pg_replication_slots
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Activity summary — NO query text, just session counts by state
activity_summary AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $129,  count(*),
    $130,             count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = $131),
    $132,               count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = $133),
    $134,count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = $135),
    $136,    count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type = $137),
    $138,    round(extract($139 FROM max(now() - xact_start))::numeric, $140),
    $141,  round(extract($142 FROM max(now() - state_change))::numeric, $143),
    $144, round(extract($145 FROM max(
                            CASE WHEN state = $146 THEN now() - state_change END
                          ))::numeric, $147),
    $148,     (
                            SELECT json_object_agg(app, cnt)
                            FROM (
                              SELECT COALESCE(application_name, $149) AS app, count(*) AS cnt
                              FROM pg_stat_activity
                              WHERE pid != pg_backend_pid()
                              GROUP BY application_name
                            ) sub
                          )
  ) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_activity
  WHERE pid != pg_backend_pid()
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
locks_summary AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    $150,   total,
    $151, granted,
    $152, waiting,
    $153, by_type,
    $154, by_mode
  ) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT
      count(*)                              AS total,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE granted)       AS granted,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted)   AS waiting,
      (SELECT json_object_agg(locktype, cnt)
       FROM (SELECT locktype, count(*) AS cnt FROM pg_locks GROUP BY locktype) t) AS by_type,
      (SELECT json_object_agg(mode, cnt)
       FROM (SELECT mode, count(*) AS cnt FROM pg_locks GROUP BY mode) m) AS by_mode
    FROM pg_locks
  ) sub
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Bloat estimate using pgstattuple approximation via catalog heuristics
-- (no actual table scan — purely statistical)
bloat_estimate AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $155,         schemaname,
    $156,          relname,
    $157,     n_live_tup,
    $158,     n_dead_tup,
    $159,     CASE WHEN (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > $160
                        THEN round($161 * n_dead_tup / (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup), $162)
                      END,
    $163,    last_vacuum,
    $164,last_autovacuum
  ) ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC NULLS LAST) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables
  WHERE (n_live_tup + n_dead_tup) > $165
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Duplicate index candidates (same table + same columns)
dup_indexes AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $166,     schema,
    $167,      tbl,
    $168, index_cols,
    $169,    index_names
  ) ORDER BY schema, tbl) AS v
  FROM (
    SELECT
      n.nspname                                    AS schema,
      c.relname                                    AS tbl,
      array_to_string(ix.indkey::int2[], $170)      AS index_cols,
      json_agg(i.relname ORDER BY i.relname)       AS index_names
    FROM pg_index ix
    JOIN pg_class i  ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid
    JOIN pg_class c  ON c.oid = ix.indrelid
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ($171, $172)
    GROUP BY n.nspname, c.relname, ix.indkey::int2[]
    HAVING count(*) > $173
  ) sub
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unused indexes (zero scans since last stats reset)
unused_indexes AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $174,      schemaname,
    $175,       relname,
    $176,       indexrelname,
    $177,  pg_relation_size(si.indexrelid),
    $178,    idx_scan,
    $179,  ix.indisprimary,
    $180,   ix.indisunique
  ) ORDER BY pg_relation_size(si.indexrelid) DESC) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_user_indexes si
  JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = si.indexrelid
  WHERE idx_scan = $181
    AND NOT ix.indisprimary
    AND NOT ix.indisunique
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Missing index candidates (high seq_scan on large tables)
missing_index_candidates AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $182,     schemaname,
    $183,      relname,
    $184,   seq_scan,
    $185, n_live_tup,
    $186, pg_total_relation_size(schemaname || $187 || quote_ident(relname))
  ) ORDER BY seq_scan DESC) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_user_tables
  WHERE seq_scan > $188
    AND n_live_tup > $189
    AND (idx_scan IS NULL OR seq_scan > idx_scan)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- WAL archiver status (mirrored from v_archiver in ultimate_report)
stat_archiver AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN has_table_privilege($190, $191)
    THEN (
      SELECT row_to_json(a) FROM (
        SELECT
          archived_count,
          last_archived_wal,
          last_archived_time,
          failed_count,
          last_failed_wal,
          last_failed_time,
          stats_reset,
          CASE
            WHEN archived_count IS NULL THEN $192
            WHEN failed_count > $193       THEN $194
            ELSE $195
          END AS status
        FROM pg_stat_archiver
      ) a
    )
    ELSE json_build_object($196, $197)
  END AS v
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- User function execution stats
stat_user_functions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $198,      schemaname,
    $199,    funcname,
    $200,       calls,
    $201,  round(total_time::numeric, $202),
    $203,   round(self_time::numeric, $204),
    $205,   CASE WHEN calls > $206 THEN round(total_time::numeric / calls, $207) END
  ) ORDER BY total_time DESC NULLS LAST) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_user_functions
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Active vacuum / analyze progress (in-flight operations)
-- PG17+: indexes_total / indexes_processed added; max_dead_tuple_bytes renamed
-- PG12-16: max_dead_tuples / num_dead_tuples (old names)
stat_progress_vacuum AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $208,                 pid,
    $209,             datname,
    $210,               relid,
    $211,               phase,
    $212,     heap_blks_total,
    $213,   heap_blks_scanned,
    $214,  heap_blks_vacuumed,
    $215,  index_vacuum_count,
    $216,       indexes_total,
    $217,   indexes_processed
  ) ORDER BY pid) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Blocking session detail (mirrors v_locks in ultimate_report)
blocking_sessions AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    $218,             pid,
    $219,         usename,
    $220,    backend_type,
    $221,        pg_blocking_pids(pid)::text,
    $222, wait_event_type,
    $223,      wait_event,
    $224,           state,
    $225,       extract($226 FROM (now() - query_start))::int,
    $227,   extract($228 FROM (now() - xact_start))::int,
    $229,   substring(query, $230, $231)
  ) ORDER BY pid) AS v
  FROM pg_stat_activity
  WHERE pg_blocking_pids(pid) <> $232
     OR (state = $233
         AND (now() - xact_start) > interval $234)
),
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- pg_stat_statements_info — PG14+, extension must be loaded
-- pg_stat_statements_info only exists on PG14+ when pg_stat_statements is installed.
stat_statements_info AS (
  SELECT $235::json AS v
)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT json_build_object(
  $236,                    (SELECT v FROM meta),
  $237,          (SELECT v FROM stat_statements),
  $238,     (SELECT v FROM stat_statements_info),
  $239,              (SELECT v FROM stat_tables),
  $240,            (SELECT v FROM statio_tables),
  $241,             (SELECT v FROM stat_indexes),
  $242,            (SELECT v FROM stat_bgwriter),
  $243,            (SELECT v FROM stat_database),
  $244,         (SELECT v FROM stat_replication),
  $245,        (SELECT v FROM replication_slots),
  $246,         (SELECT v FROM activity_summary),
  $247,            (SELECT v FROM locks_summary),
  $248,        (SELECT v FROM blocking_sessions),
  $249,           (SELECT v FROM bloat_estimate),
  $250,              (SELECT v FROM dup_indexes),
  $251,           (SELECT v FROM unused_indexes),
  $252, (SELECT v FROM missing_index_candidates),
  $253,            (SELECT v FROM stat_archiver),
  $254,      (SELECT v FROM stat_user_functions),
  $255,     (SELECT v FROM stat_progress_vacuum)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales.customers (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales.orders (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, customer_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.customers(id),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', total_cents integer NOT NULL CHECK (total_cents >= 0),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sales.order_items (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sku text NOT NULL, qty integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, unit_cents integer NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing.payments (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, invoice_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES billing.invoices(id),
  method text NOT NULL, captured_at timestamptz)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS billing.invoices (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES sales.orders(id),
  issued_on date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, amount_cents integer NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE sales.orders ADD CONSTRAINT orders_customer_fk FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES sales.customers(id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW sales.v_order_totals AS
  SELECT o.id, o.status, sum(oi.qty * oi.unit_cents) AS total_cents
  FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id, o.status

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION billing.touch_invoice() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN NEW.issued_on := COALESCE(NEW.issued_on, current_date); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS orders_customer_idx_dup ON sales.orders(customer_id)
